item.title: Week 10: Bills at Jets
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: BUF -8.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model NYJ 33% vs. market 20% | On paper Buffalo has the edge (Buffalo ranks 9th in EPA per dropback, +0.17). Under center, Josh Allen ranks 10th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Geno Smith ranks 17th; x-factor: Khalil Shakir averages 4.4 yards of separation, 2nd of 76, and the Jets' pass defense ranks 31st. The model favors Buffalo at 67%, mostly on passing matchup (3.8 pts) and rushing matchup (2.1 pts).
